Nka hali ni bana in taamasiɲɛ tɛ mɔgɔ min na, a tigi bɛ se ka a yɛlɛma mɔgɔ wɛrɛ la a sɔrɔlen tile damadama kɔfɛ.Nkaǹkaconjmais halihálìprtmême niníconjsi banabànanmaladie inìndtmDEF taamasiɲɛtàamashyɛnnmarque tɛtɛ́copCOP.NEG mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme minmîndtmREL nanáppà , aàpers3SG tigitìginmaître bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sesévarriver kakàpmINF aàpers3SG yɛlɛmayɛ̀lɛmavchanger mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme wɛrɛwɛ́rɛdtmautre laláppà aàpers3SG sɔrɔlensɔ̀rɔlenptcpsɔ̀rɔvobtenirlenmrphPTCP.RES tiletìlensoleil damadamadámadamadtmquelques-uns kɔfɛkɔ́fɛ̀ppderrièrekɔ́ndosfɛ̀pppar .

Sopisi furakɛcogo:Sopisisòpisinblennorragie furakɛcogofúrakɛcogonfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfairecógonmanière :

Fɔlɔ, sopisi tun bɛ furakɛ ni penisilini ye.Fɔlɔfɔ́lɔ̀advautrefois , sopisisòpisinblennorragie tuntùnprtPST bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF furakɛfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfaire niniconjet penisilinipenisilininpénicilline yeyéppPP . A ka fisa an ka ladilikan ɲini an ka sigidamɔgɔw fɛ, walasa ka a dɔn fura minnu da ka di ani minnu sɔrɔ ka di an ka sigidaw la.Aàpers3SG kakapmQUAL.AFF fisafìsavqmieux anánpers1PL kakapmSBJV ladilikanláadilikannconseilláadivconseillerlimrphNMLZkánncou ɲiniɲínivchercher anánpers1PL kakappPOSS sigidamɔgɔwsìgidamɔgɔwnsìgidanlocalitésìgivasseoirdánbouchemɔ̀gɔnhommewmrphPL fɛfɛ̀pppar , walasawálasaconjpour.que kakàpmINF aàpers3SG dɔndɔ́nvconnaître furafúranfeuille minnumínnudtmREL.PL2mîndtmRELlumrphPL2 dadánbouche kakapmQUAL.AFF didívqagréable aniàníconjainsi.que minnumínnuprnREL.PL2mînprnRELlumrphPL2 sɔrɔsɔ̀rɔngain kakapmQUAL.AFF didívqagréable anánpers1PL kakappPOSS sigidawsìgidawnsìgidanlocalitésìgivasseoirdánbouchewmrphPL laláppà . Fura minnu bɛ kɛ ka sopisi ni damajalan furakɛ, olu tɔgɔ bɛ sɔrɔ sɛbɛn ɲɛ Damajalan ni npɔrɔn furaw na.Furafúranfeuille minnumínnudtmREL.PL2mîndtmRELlumrphPL2 bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF kɛkɛ́vfaire kakàpmINF sopisisòpisinblennorragie niniconjet damajalandámajalannblennorragiejàlanadjsec furakɛfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfaire , oluòlûpersce.PL2òprncelumrphPL2 tɔgɔtɔ́gɔnnom bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sɔrɔsɔ̀rɔvobtenir sɛbɛnsɛ́bɛnnécrit ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Damajalandámajalannblennorragiejàlanadjsec niniconjet npɔrɔnnpɔ̀rɔnnsyphilis furawfúrawnfúranfeuillewmrphPL nanáppà . Ni ji ni dimi ma ban tile 2 walima tile 3 furakɛli kɔfɛ, o bɛ a jira ko sopisi sera fura kɔrɔ walima ko damajalan de bɛ a tigi la.Niníconjsi jijíneau niniconjet dimidíminsouffrance mamapmPFV.NEG banbánvterminer tiletìlensoleil 22numCARDINAL walimawàlímàconjou.bien tiletìlensoleil 33numCARDINAL furakɛlifúrakɛlintraitementfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfairelimrphNMLZ kɔfɛkɔ́fɛ̀ppderrièrekɔ́ndosfɛ̀pppar , oòprnce bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF aàpers3SG jirajìravmontrer kokócopQUOT sopisisòpisinblennorragie seraséravsévarriverramrphPFV.INTR furafúranfeuille kɔrɔkɔ́rɔppsous walimawàlímàconjou.bien kokócopQUOT damajalandámajalannblennorragiejàlanadjsec dedèprtFOC bɛbɛ́copêtre aàpers3SG tigitìginmaître laláppà . Ni sopisi walima damajalan bɛ muso min na, ni farigan ni barakɔrɔladimi bɛ a senkɔrɔ, o bɛ se ka kɛ tɔkɔkolodimi ye (aw ye sɛbɛn ɲɛ Muso ka barakɔrɔladimi lajɛ).Niníconjsi sopisisòpisinblennorragie walimawàlímàconjou.bien damajalandámajalannblennorragiejàlanadjsec bɛbɛ́copêtre musomùsonfemme minmîndtmREL nanáppà , niníconjsi fariganfàrigannfièvrefàrincorpsgànnfièvre niniconjet barakɔrɔladimibàrakɔrɔladiminbàrakɔrɔlanbas-ventrebàrancalebassekɔ́rɔndessouslamrphLOCdíminsouffrance bɛbɛ́copêtre aàpers3SG senkɔrɔsènkɔ́rɔppparmisènnjambekɔ́rɔppsous , oòprnce bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sesévarriver kakàpmINF kɛkɛ́vfaire tɔkɔkolodimitɔ̀gɔkolodimincoxalgietɔ̀gɔnhanchekólonosdíminsouffrance yeyéppPP ( awáwpers2PL.EMPH yeyépmIMP sɛbɛnsɛ́bɛnnécrit ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Musomùsonfemme kakappPOSS barakɔrɔladimibàrakɔrɔladiminbàrakɔrɔlanbas-ventrebàrancalebassekɔ́rɔndessouslamrphLOCdíminsouffrance lajɛlájɛvregarderlámrphCAUSjɛ́vblanchir ) . Aw ye kafoɲɔgɔn kɛ mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ fɛ, aw bɛ olu bɛɛ yɔrɔ ɲini ka a fɔ u ye u ka taa u yɛrɛ furakɛ.Awáwpers2PL.EMPH yeyepmPFV.TR kafoɲɔgɔnkàfoɲɔgɔnyanrelations.sexuelleskàfoɲɔgɔnnamikàfovrassemblerɲɔgɔnmrphRECPyamrphABSTR kɛkɛ́vfaire mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme oôconjDISTR mɔgɔmɔ̀gɔnhomme fɛfɛ̀pppar , awáwpers2PL.EMPH bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF oluòlûpersce.PL2òprncelumrphPL2 bɛɛbɛ́ɛdtmtout yɔrɔyɔ́rɔnlieu ɲiniɲínivchercher kakàpmINF aàpers3SG fɔfɔ́vdire uùpers3PL yeyéppPP uùpers3PL kakapmSBJV taatáavaller uùpers3PL yɛrɛyɛ̀rɛ̂dtmmême furakɛfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfaire . Ni cɛ jɛra a muso fɛ bana in sɔrɔlen kɔfɛ, muso ni a cɛ bɛɛ ka kan ka u yɛrɛ furakɛ.Niníconjsi cɛcɛ̀nmâle jɛrajɛ̀ravjɛ̀vassemblerramrphPFV.INTR aàpers3SG musomùsonfemme fɛfɛ̀pppar banabànanmaladie inìndtmDEF sɔrɔlensɔ̀rɔlenptcpsɔ̀rɔvobtenirlenmrphPTCP.RES kɔfɛkɔ́fɛ̀ppderrièrekɔ́ndosfɛ̀pppar , musomùsonfemme niniconjet aàpers3SG cɛcɛ́ppentre bɛɛbɛ́ɛprnchacun kakapmQUAL.AFF kankánvqégal kakàpmINF uùpers3PL yɛrɛyɛ̀rɛ̂dtmmême furakɛfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfaire . Hali ni bana taamasiɲɛw ma ye muso la, a ka kan ka a yɛrɛ furakɛ, ni o tɛ, a bɛna a yɛlɛma cɛ fɛ tuguni.Halihálìprtmême niníconjsi banabànanmaladie taamasiɲɛwtàamashiyɛnwntàamashyɛnnmarquewmrphPL mamapmPFV.NEG yeyévvoir musomùsonfemme laláppà , aàpers3SG kakapmQUAL.AFF kankánvqégal kakàpmINF aàpers3SG yɛrɛyɛ̀rɛ̂dtmmême furakɛfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfaire , niníconjsi oòprnce tɛtɛ́copCOP.NEG , aàpers3SG bɛnabɛ́nàpmFUT aàpers3SG yɛlɛmayɛ̀lɛmavchanger cɛcɛ̀nmâle fɛfɛ̀pppar tugunitúguniadvencoreniconjet .
